---
title: "t1_tryCatch"
output: html_document
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
source(Sys.getenv("WEFT_SETUP", "setup.R")); clag_install()
depth <- 0.3
```

```{r first, error=FALSE}
r <- tryCatch(claim(depth, . > 0.5), error = function(e) "caught"); print(r)
```

```{r second}
cat("SECOND CHUNK RAN\n")
```

Prose with a passing value `r claim(depth, . < 0.5)`{.num}.
